required: directly tied to the hydrological purpose
absolute or externally anchored acceptance meaning
time scale or temporal-allocation semantics specified or defensibly bounded
not merely measurement error, numerical closure, or generic goodness-of-fit
eligibility_rule.primary_gate: criterion vector; no weighted composite score

useful_external_authority: Purpose-specific groundwater prediction criteria must be defined from intended use.
Recharge uncertainty can be mapped to head/flow consequences through a prediction-specific groundwater sensitivity model.
Temporal aggregation of recharge can alter groundwater-system responses and must therefore be explicit.

rejected_threshold_candidates.reason: Numerical/accounting closure criterion; not allowed recharge-boundary representation error.
Case-specific synthetic estimability result, not a normative application threshold.
Supported only for specific systems/applications; no portable absolute error tolerance follows.

useful_external_authority: Recharge-to-head consequences are prediction- and system-specific.
Head sensitivity varies strongly between sites; mapping requires groundwater-system properties and a defined prediction endpoint.
Temporal resolution can matter strongly for shallow groundwater and groundwater-surface-water exchange.

rejected_threshold_candidates.candidate: fixed absolute recharge-flux tolerance inferred from head sensitivity
rejected_threshold_candidates.reason: No portable mapping exists without an authorized groundwater response model and target head consequence.
Calibration goodness-of-fit is not an exchange/reversal acceptance requirement.

rejected_threshold_candidates.candidate: zero sign/reversal error as externally required rule
rejected_threshold_candidates.reason: Scientifically attractive as a diagnostic, but no independent application authority was found that makes it the acceptance threshold for GW-D.

SCI-P.target: profile/process research including soil moisture, zone storage, local flux, gradient, timing and extrema
useful_external_authority: Soil-moisture product and model-validation literature provides empirical error magnitudes and sensor/product requirements.
Fit-for-purpose literature requires scientific-purpose criteria to be defined explicitly before evaluation.

rejected_threshold_candidates.reason: SMAP remote-sensing product requirement; not a Layer-ROM process/profile research fidelity requirement.

rejected_threshold_candidates.candidate: empirical VWC RMSE bands from individual studies
rejected_threshold_candidates.reason: Achieved/model-specific performance, not independent process-model sufficiency authority.

cross_purpose_decision.reason: No purpose has sufficiently direct independent absolute tolerance authority to freeze a defensible acceptance envelope without introducing a new scientific choice.

consequence: Do not preregister a numerical acceptance envelope or expose a new blind Reference/candidate panel until purpose-owner or independently traceable application requirements provide the missing thresholds and temporal semantics.
non_conclusions: No statement that Layer-ROM fails any application.
No statement that Layer-ROM passes any application.
No ranking among L4, L6 and R8.
No change to existing shared-host cost evidence.
